newsitem.title: USA: Conrail sets Dec. 23 shareholder meeting.
newsitem.headline: Conrail sets Dec. 23 shareholder meeting.

text.p: Conrail Inc said it has set a special shareholder meeting for December 23 in connection with its proposed merger with CSX Corp.

At the meeting, shareholders will be asked to permit CSX to buy 40 percent of Conrail in a cash tender offer. CSX has acquired 19.9 percent so far, but is prohibited from tendering for more Conrail shares without shareholder approval.
Conrail also said it has begun mailing out proxy materials to its shareholders.
The vote will require the approval of a majority of Conrail shares in order to pass.
The proposed merger calls for CSX to buy 40 percent of Conrail shares for $110 cash per share and exchange the rest for CSX stock.
The deal has been opposed by Norfolk Southern Corp, which launched its own all-cash $110 per share offer for Conrail.
Conrail has rejected the Norfolk Southern offer, contending that its union with CSX would provide greater strategic benefits.
